title: Coca-Cola Consolidated Recognized as one of America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek

body_markdown:
**CHARLOTTE, N.C., Aug. 25, 2026** **–** Coca-Cola Consolidated, the nation’s largest Coca-Cola bottler, is honored to be named to the 2026 “America’s Greatest Workplaces by State” list by Newsweek. Listed for the state of North Carolina, the ranking highlights employers excelling in leadership, fair compensation and work-life balance. Based on more than 575,000 interviews and 7.6 million reviews, the assessment identifies employers excelling in employee satisfaction across the country.


“We are honored to be featured as one of America’s Greatest Workplaces,” said Brent Tollison, Chief People and Public Affairs Officer. “This recognition underscores the remarkable contributions of Coca-Cola Consolidated’s more than 17,000 Teammates, whose commitment to supporting one another, serving our customers and strengthening our communities is reflected in all they do. We are honored to embrace a culture that builds meaningful careers and inspires our teammates to reach their fullest potential.”


Coca-Cola Consolidated was ranked among other American companies based on their performance across 10 key dimensions of workplace satisfaction. The comprehensive study combined both national and in-state recommendations for employers with 1,000 or more employees. The full list of recipients can be viewed on the Newsweek website.


Learn more about Coca-Cola Consolidated and its available[career opportunities](http://www.work4coke.com/) .
